semiconductor_relevance: High — Kuraray provides specialized chemicals and materials that are critical for semiconductor processing and manufacturing.
summary: Kuraray Co., Ltd. is a Japanese chemical manufacturer offering a range of materials and solutions for the semiconductor industry, including cleaning solvents, activated carbon for water purification, and polymeric materials like PVA and PVB resins. Their products are designed to enhance manufacturing processes and improve environmental sustainability.
capabilities: Activated carbon products for advanced water purification
Hollow-fiber membrane modules for wastewater recycling
Polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) and polyvinyl butyral (PVB) resins

regional_presence.Japan: Kuraray is headquartered in Japan and operates in over 30 countries, focusing on global market solutions.
